messages:
maya: FYI nightly canary failed on shard gpu-node-12 during quantized-smoke run. stack is small but looks like a PCIe link/driver noise before OOM.
evan: ugh. any logs? job id?
maya: job 2026-03-16T02:12Z canary-quant-7. attaching key snippets below. reproduced on one node locally.
li: can you paste the dmesg and nvidia-smi output?
maya: dmesg:
  [ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
  [ 1234.568012] nvrm: GPU at 0000:65:00 NACKing commands

nvidia-smi -q snippet:
  Driver Version: 545.85.12
  CUDA Version: 12.2
  Attached GPUs : 1
  GPU 0000:65:00: MIG 0
  ECC Errors: corrected single-bit 3

ashley: 79 is often a bad sign for a hw/reset. could be driver/node mismatch after the kernel upgrade last week.
ops-tim: I see a host kernel update rolled to that AZ yesterday. rolling back kernel on a canary node now.
ci-bot: rerun requested by maya: /rerun job canary-quant-7 --shard gpu-node-12
evan: also saw a few runs where the quantized runner allocs spike right before the Xid. maybe mem-frag or bad driver memory accounting.
li: on my repro I got cuCtxCreate errors: "CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN: driver shutting down" right after the Xid.
maya: here's the failing test log (minimal):
  INFO model_runner: starting batch=4 seq_len=2048
  INFO kv_cache: warmup done
  ERROR gpu: kernel launch timed out, aborting token loop
  RuntimeError: cuBLAS launch failed: 700 (unknown)
ashley: can we triage whether it's purely driver/kbox or also an app-level regression? any recent PRs touching allocator or cuda flags?
maya: last two PRs touched continuous-batching and allocator heuristics but both passed unit and CI earlier. scheduling a bisect tomorrow if rollback doesn't fix.
ops-tim: rollback in AZ complete, requeueing the canary to the patched nodes.
ci-bot: rerun started: canary-quant-7 (retry 1)
maya: thanks. if this clears after rollback we should pin kernel/driver combo in canary pool and escalate to infra to avoid rolling host kernel globally until we confirm.
evan: agree. if it persists after rollback we'll need a bisect + core dump from the GPU node. please capture /var/log/nvidia-installer.log and full dmesg when it happens.
li: I'll try a smaller reproducer with batch=1 and leak-checker to see if allocation pattern triggers it.
ashley: pinging eng-infra on the ticket: infra@redwood-inference
maya: tagging for followup, will update once rerun finishes. :eyes:
